proposition: In the R. Shaqq-i Qamar Ibn Turka assigns the dialectical theologians (the text also names philosophers of Islam) to level two; on Q 54:1 they agree with level one that the moon was split but argue from God's free agency that it was possible, a miracle confirming the Prophet against deniers. Ibn Turka says God's wisdom has confined them to this level as well.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: the dissertation's summary names only the theologians at level two; the translated primary text also names philosophers, see notes
